messages:
Emily: Heads-up — Joe's bday is next Friday (May 2). In-office folks: want to do a surprise lunch? Poll below. @channel
birthday-bot: Reminder: Joe's birthday on 2025-05-02. Add a birthday emoji! :tada:
Carlos: I'm in for decorations. Can bring streamers and a cake topper.
Priya: Pizza vs sushi vs tacos? Vote with reactions please. I'm leaning tacos.
Jamal: Tacos for sure. Also can do a gluten-free/vegan option — I can bring a vegan tray.
Linh: I'll make a Spotify playlist. Any song requests for Joe? He loves 90s rock.
Mateo: Remote folks: would you like a digital card and a $25 e-gift? I can coordinate.
Emily: Yes please for the card. Also volunteers for setting up at 11:30 — @Carlos @Linh?
Carlos: I can be there at 11:15.
Priya: I can pick up food if someone covers the order cost.
Mateo: I'll handle the e-gift. DM me names and emails.
Jamal: +1 on decorations. Do we want balloons? Low-key confetti?
Linh: No confetti in the server room 😅 maybe paper garlands.
Emily: Ok plan: tacos (main), small pizza as backup; vegan tray; Linh playlist; Mateo e-gift & card; Carlos + Jamal decorations. I'll post a checklist tomorrow. Thanks y'all! :partyparrot:
Priya: :thumbsup:
birthday-bot: Event created: "Joe's Surprise Lunch" next Fri 12:00 — reminder set for organizers.
